name: secret-guard
description: Keeps secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys) out of the model's context: hides them in tool output and asks before a typed prompt that contains one is sent.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. You can also type secret-guard off / secret-guard on in a session (remembered).

redactEmails.title: Also hide email addresses
redactEmails.description: Off by default: sample IDs and cluster names often look like emails. IP addresses are never hidden.

askOnPrompt.title: Ask before sending a prompt with a secret
askOnPrompt.description: When a prompt you type contains a secret-looking string, ask: send redacted, send as typed, or hold it.

extraPatterns.title: Extra patterns (regular expressions)
extraPatterns.description: Optional. JavaScript regular expressions separated by ;; each one hides what it matches as [secret:custom]. A bad one is reported by typing secret-guard, never thrown.
